Name: Cenoon Gacha Plushies
Author: Cenooooon
Description:
🧸 Unique Gacha Plushies: Ultimate Collectible Decor!
Are you looking to cozy up your farmhouse with some adorable new roommates? Do you live for the thrill of mystery boxes and gacha pulls? Look no further! This mod introduces a massive, dynamic plushie collection system to Stardew Valley that will turn your home decoration into an exciting hunting game.
[heading]✨ Key Features[/heading]
1. Absolute Variety – No Two Plushies Are Alike!
The heart of this mod lies in its [b]infinite randomization system[/b]. While there are [b]3 base plushie types[/b], the combinations are endless:
[list]
[*]🎨 [b]Vibrant Color Palettes:[/b] From soft, sweet pastels to bold, unique shades.[/*]
[*]📐 [b]Diverse Shapes:[/b] Multiple shapes, sizes, and cute facial expressions.[/*]
[*]🎀 [b]Cute Accessories:[/b] Each plushie is randomly dressed up with unique accessories (bows, hats, shirts, glasses, and more!).[/*]
[/list][quote]💡 [b]The Ultimate Collectible:[/b] Thanks to the randomized combination algorithm, [b]no two plushies will ever look the same![/b] Every single unboxing guarantees a 100% unique "one-of-a-kind" masterpiece. The hype and anticipation of seeing what your next plushie looks like will keep you hooked![/quote]2. Get Your Mystery Boxes at The Stardrop Saloon
No need to grind deep in dangerous mines or wait for rare yearly festivals. You can purchase your [b]Plushie Mystery Box[/b] directly from Gus at [b]The Stardrop Saloon[/b].
[list]
[*]💰 [b]Price:[/b]
[code]50,000g[/code]per box. [i](A perfect late-game gold sink for wealthy farmers looking to complete the ultimate luxury collection!)[/i][/*]
[/list]3. Dual Language Support (Localization)
The mod comes fully localized out of the box:
[list]
[*]🇬🇧 [b]English:[/b] Default language.[/*]
[*]🇻🇳 [b]Vietnamese:[/b] Fully translated with natural phrasing for the Vietnamese community.[/*]
[/list][heading]🛠 Requirements & Installation[/heading]
To run this mod smoothly without any issues, you will need the standard Stardew Valley modding tool:
[list]
[*][b]SMAPI[/b] (Stardew Modding API) – Latest version required.[/*]
[/list]💻 Quick Installation Guide:
[list=1]
[*]Download and install [b]SMAPI[/b].[/*]
[*]Extract this mod's folder and drop it into your
[code]Mods[/code]directory inside your Stardew Valley game folder.[/*]
[*]Launch the game through SMAPI and start unboxing![/*]
[/list]Good luck on your journey to find the perfect plushie companion! If you have any feedback, suggestions, or bug reports, feel free to leave a comment below. Happy farming! 🎉
